execution.CUDA_scope_limit: Installed after torch import; that import interval and unwrapped native calls are not monitored. Real availability queries require False/0. Own operations use explicit CPU devices.
execution.memory_accounting_limit: RSS and memcg charge are different measurements; their difference does not establish large-model memory cost.
execution.retention_limit: First63 plus one latest runtime sample,64 retained total; minimum is over retained samples only, not all192.
execution.saved_closure: authenticated selected unit stopped, cgroup absent, observed cohort exit confirmed; no full-tree/no-escape claim

limitations: CPU same-device tiny module.forward mechanics only; no GPU transfer or UMA result.
No 12B loading,8192 context,20s workload,N3/Q95,browser usefulness or quality/benchmark score qualification.
Positive numerical parity does not preserve parameter object tie, requires_grad flags or version-counter availability.

mmap_external_state.file_integrity: Actor recorded matching generated/mmap hash and ownfile_integrity_final=true; auditor checked stat identity, not payload hash.
mmap_external_state.read_only_limit: rw-p private writable/COW mapping; chmod0444 and saved unchanged file hash do not make tensors immutable.

numerical.actual_offload_assertions: Pinned actor source and successful completed path require two exact torch.equal base forwards, two LoRA forwards, disabled baseline equality and re-enabled equality. Saved two_forwards_equal=true for both. Per-call raw offload outputs are not persisted, so those comparisons are source-and-success-backed assertion evidence rather than an independent replay.
numerical.independent_stdlib_recomputation: BF16 round-to-nearest-even on exact dyadic small float32 sums, from checked fixture constants; ids0,2,5, embed[j]=j/32, projection=I/2, LoRA A=.125 B=.25 scale1. No tensor file read.
numerical.lora_AB_not_in_original_body_trace: Their hook refs/parameter snapshots and numerical assertions are evidence; no direct A/B body trace is claimed.
numerical.trace_partition: 0-2 initial baseline;3-8 two base offload;9-14 initial LoRA on/off;15-20 two LoRA offload;21-26 offloaded off/on;27-28 controlled embed/proj failure prefix.

parameter_semantics.adapter_dtype: Both actual LoRA A/B float32; base mapped weights BF16.
parameter_semantics.id_reuse_limit: id() addresses can be reused across non-overlapping lifetimes; equal IDs across different trace times do not prove tied objects.
parameter_semantics.requires_grad: Saved LoRA_before_offload already has both A/B requires_grad=true (and remains true through final snapshots); base weights stay false. False-to-true is source-backed inference from model.requires_grad_(False) then disable_adapter exit -> enable_adapters -> set_adapter default inference_mode=False. No paired pre-context snapshot exists. No gradient computation or training is inferred from these flags.
parameter_semantics.version_counters: CPU base counters0 and LoRA counters3; after inference forwards all offloaded meta parameters report no version counter; explicit detach restores CPU0/3. This is replacement/lifetime behavior, not unchanged parameter identity or version qualification.

scope: Saved-only stdlib audit; no framework import, actor/service/HTTP operation or tensor payload read. New metadata only; actual inputs unchanged.
